caption: The drawing depicts a stylized figure standing on a rectangular gray base. The figure is predominantly dressed in blue with a pink inner garment and has a light brown face with distinct black outlines for facial features. The figure is crowned with a blue headpiece that has a jagged edge and does not have detailed texture. The hands are positioned together in front, with pink coloring for the skin. Surrounding the figure are symmetrical, radiating shapes in red, black, and yellow, forming a spiked halo or background. The lower portion of the garment features a small red face on a rounded surface, with white and blue details around it. The overall composition is centralized with the figure occupying the majority of the image, and there are no visible objects other than the figure and the base. The colors used are primarily blue, pink, red, black, yellow, white, and gray.
title: Plate 31: Our Lady of Guadalupe: From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
